get.description: Downloads the audio recording for a voice conversation session identified by its internal session ID. The content type reflects the actual file format and may vary. Available from version 261.

404.description: Not Found - session does not exist or has no recording

delete.description: Permanently deletes the audio recording associated with a conversation session. The recording is removed from Storage and the session's recording is marked as Deleted. Recordings held by an external system cannot be deleted via this API and will return 400. Returns 404 if no recording exists for this session.

400.description: Bad Request - recording is externally hosted and cannot be deleted via this API. Error code: RecordingNotDeletable.

404.description: Not Found - conversation does not exist or has no recording to delete

post.description: Search for conversation sessions with filtering and pagination support. Returns session details including metadata, message counts, call summaries, and more. Available from version 260.

Schedules the audio recording associated with a conversation session to be deleted at the given time. A background job deletes the recording once the scheduled time has passed. If a deletion is already scheduled for this session, the existing schedule is overwritten. Recordings held by an external system cannot be scheduled for deletion via this API and will return 400.

400.description: Bad Request - either deletionTime is invalid/not in the future (code InvalidDeletionTime) or the recording is externally hosted and cannot be scheduled for deletion (code RecordingNotDeletable)

404.description: Not Found - conversation does not exist, has no recording to schedule for deletion, or the recording was deleted concurrently (e.g. by a prior scheduled or instant deletion)

get.description:
Export all knowledge items, sorted alphabetically by a key, as a CSV file. Available from version 257.

CSV format: key, value, expiresAt (optional, ISO 8601 date format)

This export format is compatible with the import endpoint.

200.description: CSV file containing all knowledge items

post.description:
Import or update knowledge base items from a CSV file. Available from version 257.

CSV format: key, value, expiresAt (optional, ISO 8601 date format)

The import operation will:
- Create new items if the key doesn't exist
- Update existing items if the key exists and values differ
- Skip items that are unchanged
- Fail for items that are used in connectors

Maximum file size: 10,000 rows

Returns a summary with counts of added, updated, and unchanged items.

Possible error codes: FileTooBig, DuplicateKeys, InvalidCsv, ImportFailed

file.description: CSV file containing knowledge base items

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid CSV format or file error

callingStart.description: Calling start date in ISO8601 format

callingEnd.description: Calling end date in ISO8601 format (max 3 days after callingStart)

callParams.description: Dynamic list of call params that can be accessed in AEL on Flow (e.g. external.clientName)

callAttemptsLimitPerDay.description: Maximum number of call attempts per day

id.description: Unique identifier of the AI credentials

name.description: Display name of the AI credentials

AiCredentialCapability.description: Specifies what AI operations this credential is authorized to perform

KnowledgeBaseDocumentInfo.description: Basic information about knowledge base document

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the document was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the document was last updated

embeddingsCredentialsId.description: Identifier of AI credentials used to generate embeddings in the document. If empty, it means the document was created using default embedding credential.

DocumentIndexationStatus.description: Current status of the knowledge record indexing process

embeddingsCredentialsId.description: Identifier of AI credentials for generating embeddings of the document. If not provided, the default embeddings credentials will be used.

publishResults.description: Results of flow publishing operations (only present when publishFlows parameter was set to true)

status.description: Status of the flow publish operation

message.description: Error message (present only for Error status)

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when flow was published (present only for Published and AlreadyPublished status)

projectIds.description: Optional list of project IDs to filter conversations. If absent, searches all projects in the company

sessionIds.description: Optional list of session IDs (external or internal session IDs) to get specific sessions

cursor.description: A pagination token returned by the API. To fetch subsequent pages, provide the nextCursor value exactly as it was returned in the previous request. Leave this field empty to fetch the beginning of the list.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per response. Defaults to 50 if not specified

from.description: Search messages from this timestamp (ISO8601 format with timezone)

to.description: Search messages to this timestamp (ISO8601 format with timezone)

recordingStatus.description: Optional filter restricting results to sessions whose audio recording lifecycle status is in the given set. If absent, no lifecycle filter is applied.

RecordingStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the session's audio recording. Uploaded: recording is present and available. ScheduledForDeletion: a deletion has been scheduled. Deleted: the recording has been removed. Unavailable: the session has no associated recording.

deletionTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the recording should be deleted. Must be strictly after the current time and at most 365 days from now.

ConversationSortBy.description: Sort by field. Default is StartTime

results.description: List of conversation sessions matching the search criteria

totalCount.description: Total number of conversations matching the criteria in the specified time frame

nextCursor.description: A token used to fetch the next page of results. Pass this exact value as the cursor query parameter in your next request. If this field is null, there are no more results.

updateTime.description: When the conversation was last updated

conversationMetadata.description: Key-value pairs of additional conversation data

userMessageCount.description: Number of messages sent by the user

botMessageCount.description: Number of messages sent by the bot

tags.description: List of tags assigned to the conversation

Recording.description: Audio recording metadata for the conversation. status=Unavailable indicates the session has no associated recording.

scheduledDeletionTime.description: Time at which the recording is scheduled to be deleted. Set when a deletion has been scheduled (status=ScheduledForDeletion); preserved as historical fact after the deletion happens (status=Deleted). Null when no deletion was ever scheduled.

deletedAt.description: Time at which the recording was actually deleted (status=Deleted). Null otherwise.

ConversationCallSummary.description: Detailed call information (primarily for voice conversations)

CallTerminationReason.description: Reason why the call was terminated

extraData.description: Additional data attached to the user message

error.description: Error details if an error occurred during processing

type.description: Discriminator value identifying a bot reply event

createdAt.description: When the bot reply was created

type.description: Discriminator value identifying a bot log event

objects.description: Map of resolved object names to their JSON values, in declaration order

createdAt.description: When the log entry was produced

intents.description: Map of detected intent names to confidence scores

params.description: Command parameters (dynamic JSON object, structure depends on command type)
